MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 27, 2025
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  3:00 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Stewart called the meeting to order at 2:41 pm.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Doug Stewart; Mayor Pro Tem Marianne Rigging; and
  Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad, Bruce Silverstein and Steve Uhring.

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION

  Mayor Stewart opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: None.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

  At 2:41 p.m., the Council recessed to Closed Session to discuss the following items listed
  on the Closed Session agenda:

Conference with Legal Counsel — Anticipated Litigation

  l.  Initiation of litigation pursuant to paragraph (4) of subdivision (d) of Government
  Code section 54956.9
  Number of potential cases: (2)

Conference with Legal Counsel — Anticipated Litigation

  1.  Significant exposure to litigation pursuant to paragraph (2) and/or (3) of
  subdivision (d) of Section 54956.9
  Number of Potential Cases: (1)

Personnel Matters pursuant to Government Code Section 54957:

  1.  Public Employee Performance Evaluation
  Title: City Manager

  2.  Public Employee Discipline/Dismissal/Release

  3.  Public Employee Appointment
  Title: Interim City Manager
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of February 27, 2025
  Page 2 of 7

Conference with Labor Negotiator pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6:

  1.  City representative: Interim City Attorney Trevor Rusin
  Unrepresented employee: City Manager

REGULAR SESSION CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Stewart called the meeting to order at 3 : 16 pm.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Doug Stewart; Mayor Pro Tem Marianne Riggins; and
  Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad, Bruce Silverstein and Steve Uhring.

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Joseph Torrey, Acting City
  Manager; Alexis Brown, Deputy City Manager; Kelsey Pettijohn, City Clerk; Yolanda
  Bundy, Environmental Sustainability Director; Maureen Tamuri, Interim Planning
  Director; Susan Duefias, Public Safety Director; Matt Myerhoff, Media Information
  Officer; Parker Davis, Media Technician; Jason Lawrence, Deputy City Clerk; Kate
  Manisco, Recreation Manager; Solishia Andico, Environmental Health Administrator;
  Julie Bauer, Supervising Permit Services Technician; Ryan Cerny, Supervising Building
  Inspector; Andre Ketchedjian, Senior Plan Check Engineer; Tracey Rossine,
  Environmental Programs Manager; Tyler Eaton, Principal Planner; Brandie Ayala, Senior
  Management Analyst; and Jorge Rubalcava, Senior Civil Engineer

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Scott Dittrich led the Pledge of Allegiance.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  Interim City Attorney Rusin reported that the meeting convened at 2:40 p.m., after which
  time the City Council recessed to a Closed Session pursuant to Government Code Sections
  54956.9, 54957, and 54957.6, with all Councilmembers present. He stated the Council
  discussed the items on the Closed Session agenda and took no reportable action. He stated
  the Council unanimously directed him to make the following statement: The City Manager
  has been on leave and the City has been working with the current City Manager on an
  agreement that would result in his separation from the City, which the City will bring back
  on the Consent Calendar at a future meeting. The City is exploring its options for the City
  Manager position and will report back to the public in the future. At this time, Joe Toney
  will continue to serve as the Acting City Manager.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of February 27, 2025
  Page 3 of 7

  City Clerk Pettijohn reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  February 26, 2025.

  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION  Councilmember Uhring moved, and Mayor Pro Tem Riggins seconded a motion to
  approve the agenda, hearing Item No. l.A. concurrently with Item No. 2.C. The
  motion carried unanimously.

  ITEM 2  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Consideration of Additional Public Workshops or Meetings for Local Coastal Plan
  Amendment and Municipal Code Amendment (LCPA/MMCA) Discussions
  Recommended Action: l) Direct staff on scheduling additional workshops or
  meetings prior to final approval of the Local Coastal Plan Amendment and the
  Municipal Code Amendment; and 2) Provide direction on the current format of the
  March 4, 2025, City Council meeting.

  Acting City Manager Toney presented the staff report.

  The Council directed questions to staff.

  Mayor Stewart opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Dean Wenner, Andrew Sheldon, Paula Logan, Jo Drummond (Peter
  Monge deferred time to Jo Drummond), and Brian Merrick

  Wade Maj or declined the opportunity to speak.

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Stewart returned the matter to the
  table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff

  CGNSENSUS
  By Consensus, the Council directed staff to notice a rebuild ordinance workshop,
  to last no longer than six hours, and the public hearing for the first reading of the
  ordinance on March 4, 2025.

  B.  Participation in the County of Los Angele Palisades Fire Debris Removal Program
  Recommended Action: 1) Authorize the City Manager to execute a Memorandum
  of Understanding (MOU) between the County of Los Angeles and the City of
  Malibu regarding the consolidated debris removal program for opt-in properties
  within the City in response to the Palisades Fire; and 2) Authorize the City Attorney
Li  or City Manager to make and enter into minor, non-material and typographical
  changes or amendments to the MOU if necessary to effectuate its purpose.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of February 27, 2025
  Page 4 of 7

  Acting City Manager Toney and Environmental Sustainability Director presented
  the staff report.

  Mayor Stewart opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Dean Wenner, Scott Dittrich, Jo Drummond, and Ryan Embree

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Stewart retumed the matter to the
  table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

MOTION  Councilmember Silverstein moved to: l) authorize the City Manager to execute a
  Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the County of Los Angeles and
  the City of Malibu regarding the consolidated debris removal program for opt—in
  properties within the City in response to the Palisades Fire; and 2) authorize the
  City Attorney or City Manager to make and enter into minor, non-material and
  typographical changes or amendments to the MOU if necessary to effectuate its
  purpose.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

  Mayor Pro Tem Riggins second the motion.

  The Council discussed the motion and directed questions to staff.

RECESS  At 4:38 p.m., Mayor Stewart recessed the meeting. The meeting resumed at 4:51
  p.m. with all Councilmembers present.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

  The motion carried unanimously.

ITEM 1  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  Malibu Rebuilds Process Overview

  Item No. 1.A. and Item No. 2.C. were heard concurrently.

ITEM 2  NEW BUSINESS (Continued)

  Fire Rebuild Policy Discussion
  Recommended Action: 1) Receive a report on the City’s post-fire recovery efforts,
  including proposals for public safety, environmental concerns, and community
  rebuilding initiatives; and 2) Provide direction to City Manager on key fire recovery
  items described in the agenda report.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of February 27, 2025
  Page 5 of 7

  Acting City Manager Toney presented the staff report.

  Mayor Stewart opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Wade Major, Drew Leonard, Luis Tena, Abe Roy (Jimmy Petulla and
  Peter Monger deferred time to Abe Roy), Janet Fulk, Dean Wenner, Robert
  Macleod (Connor Macleod deferred time to Robert Macleod), Scott Dittrich, Norm
  Haynie, Lea Johnson, Reg Browne, Jefferson Wagner, Raymond Portela, Ryan
  Embree

  Councilmember Conrad left the dais.

  Speakers: Jo Drummond (Colin Drummond and Julie Masterson deferred time to
  Jo Drummond)

  Councilmember Conrad returned to the dais.

  Speakers: Nora Cohen, DNA Moore, and Lester Tobias

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Stewart returned the matter to the
  table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to bring back an item to considering
  waiving rebuild permit fees.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

MOTION  Councilmember Silverstein moved, Mayor Stewart second a motion to direct the
  City Manager to purchase lunch for staff from local businesses and bring back an
  item for budget appropriation, if necessary. The motion carried unanimously.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to bring back an item on economic
  development to support local businesses during recovery.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to bring back an item to consider reducing
  noticing requirements and other permitting requirements for events and to support
  local businesses during recovery.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of February 27, 2025
  Page 6 of 7

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to explore options for security in the fire
  burn area.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to bring back an item at a special meeting
  on sewer options and OWTS systems for fire rebuilds.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to schedule an insurance workshop and
  work with Councilmember Silverstein.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to bring back an item to consider
  requesting Los Angeles County to declare an eviction moratorium.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

  Councilmember Conrad left the dais at 7:28 p.m.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

  Councilmember Conrad returned to the dais at 7:50 p.m.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to reach out to local universities to
  determine if they can provide assistance with environmental testing.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to schedule a special meeting to discuss
  the recovery center rebuild organization structure, including considering a Rebuild
  Czar or neighborhood liaison position.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of February 27, 2025
  Page 7 of 7

  ADJOURNMENT

  At 8:39 p.m., Mayor Pro Tem Riggins moved, and Mayor Stewart seconded a motion to
  adj ourn the meeting. The motion carried unanimously.

  Approved and adopted by the City Council of the
  C ity of Malibu on May 27, 2025.

  MARIA  E RIGGINS,
